_syllabus_items.title: Required practical 1: the effect of a named variable on the rate of an enzyme-controlled reaction
Required practical 2: stained root-tip squashes, identifying the stages of mitosis with an optical microscope and calculating a mitotic index
Required practical 3: a dilution series and calibration curve to find the water potential of plant tissue
Required practical 4: the effect of a named variable on the permeability of cell-surface membranes
Required practical 5: dissection of an animal or plant gas exchange or mass transport system, or of an organ within one
Required practical 6: aseptic techniques to investigate the effect of antimicrobial substances on microbial growth
Required practical 7: chromatography of photosynthetic pigments from the leaves of different plants
Required practical 8: the effect of a named factor on the rate of dehydrogenase activity in extracts of chloroplasts
Required practical 9: the effect of a named variable on the rate of respiration of cultures of single-celled organisms
Required practical 10: the effect of an environmental variable on the movement of an animal using a choice chamber or maze
Required practical 11: a glucose dilution series and colorimetric calibration curve to find the glucose concentration of an unknown 'urine' sample
Required practical 12: the effect of a named environmental factor on the distribution of a given species
